# Beat-synced video transitions — infinite zoom, shake cut, tile flip

**Two shots and a beat grid become a timed transition: Droste zoom, shake cut, tile flip, bokeh, photo cloud or collage burst.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_0311038082fa.webp" alt="A Droste zoom dives into a monitor in a dark room until its mountain sunset fills the frame, then an impact tile-flip mosaic reveals a night skyline." width="480"></p>

Six transitions with exact presets and the editing rules behind them: photo collage burst, Droste recursive zoom into a screen, impact tile-flip mosaic, bokeh light-spot transition, 3D photo cloud gallery and a camera-shake distort cut. Presets give the core length in frames, where the peak lands on the beat, log-space zooms, shake amplitude, frequency and decay, motion-blur shutter angle, bokeh sizes, tile counts and stagger, from Walter Murch, Dan Ebberts' decaying-sine expression, Boris FX, Maxon and Unreal camera-shake defaults, measured transition durations and editors on X. Use when a video needs a transition on the beat, an infinite zoom, a shake cut, a bokeh or photo-collage transition. NOT for plain crossfades and xfade wipes (varg-video-edit-library lists every ffmpeg xfade).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill transition-craft                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills transition-craft --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Add a camera-shake cut on every bass hit in ./reel.mp4 using the beats in ./beats.json"
- "Make an infinite Droste zoom into the laptop screen that lands on shot 2"
- "Photo collage burst transition with the 12 photos in ./pics/, peaking on the downbeat"
